CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFEXECUTE

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

CFEXECUTE starts a program on the server machine, such as a shell utility or a batch report. Its output goes into the page at the point of the tag, or into a file.

Category

File, directory and system

Syntax

<CFEXECUTE NAME="application_name"
    ARGUMENTS="command_line_arguments"
    OUTPUTFILE="output_file_name"
    TIMEOUT="timeout_in_seconds">
</CFEXECUTE>

Attributes

NAME
Required. The program to run. A full path such as /bin/date is safest; a bare name is looked up in the server's PATH.
ARGUMENTS
Optional. Arguments for the program, separated by spaces.
OUTPUTFILE
Optional. File that receives the output instead of the page.
TIMEOUT
Optional, default "0". Seconds to wait for the program. With 0, KoldFusion starts the program and carries on at once without collecting any output.

Usage

The program runs directly, not through a shell: pipes, redirection and wildcards such as *.txt are passed along literally. Error output (stderr) is captured together with normal output. A program that cannot be found simply produces no output.

If the program is still running when TIMEOUT expires, it is stopped and an Application exception ("Timeout period expired for CFEXECUTE.") is thrown. Always give a TIMEOUT if you want to see the output. The end tag is required. Because this tag can run anything the server account may run, it can be restricted on the Basic Security page of the Administrator.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<P>The server's clock says:
<B><CFEXECUTE NAME="/bin/date" ARGUMENTS="+%m/%d/%Y" TIMEOUT="5"></CFEXECUTE></B></P>

<!--- Capture output in a file, then read it back --->
<CFSET OutFile = GetTempDirectory() & "cfexecute_demo.txt">
<CFEXECUTE NAME="/bin/echo" ARGUMENTS="Greetings from the command line" OUTPUTFILE="#OutFile#" TIMEOUT="5">
</CFEXECUTE>
<CFFILE ACTION="READ" FILE="#OutFile#" VARIABLE="Captured">
<CFFILE ACTION="DELETE" FILE="#OutFile#">
<CFOUTPUT><P>From OUTPUTFILE: <TT>#HTMLEditFormat(Trim(Captured))#</TT></P></CFOUTPUT>

<!--- A program that takes too long --->
<CFTRY>
  <CFEXECUTE NAME="/bin/sleep" ARGUMENTS="5" TIMEOUT="1"></CFEXECUTE>
  <CFCATCH TYPE="Application">
    <CFOUTPUT><P><B>#CFCATCH.Message#</B> #CFCATCH.Detail#</P></CFOUTPUT>
  </CFCATCH>
</CFTRY>

See also

CFFILE, CFSCHEDULE, CFTRY, GetTempDirectory
